NoirPanther server **0.1.7-r1** — built from Stump **0.1.7**: everything in that Stump release plus
the fork's additions (see the README for the full list).

## What's new in this revision

- **New version scheme**: `<Stump version>-r<N>`. The first part is the Stump release the build is
  made from, `rN` is the NoirPanther revision on top of it (previous builds were labelled
  `0.1.7-vint-0.5.0`). Docker tags follow: `:0.1.7-r1` (pinned), `:0.1.7` (newest revision on Stump
  0.1.7), `:latest`.
- **Update notice that works**: the server checks this repository's releases and shows a notice with
  a link to the release notes in _Settings → Server → General_ when a newer release exists. (In
  upstream the web app asks a route the server doesn't have, so the notice never appears.)
- README: docker compose examples for both SQLite and PostgreSQL, a Versioning section.
